title: 16-Bit Entry Count Truncation in writeZip
description: writeZip wrote the entry count to End of Central Directory using setUint16 without checking if entries.length >= 0xffff. Archives with 65,536 or more entries silently truncated to 0, corrupting headers.
verifier_notes: Disprover confirmed vulnerability. Preflight guard added in writeZip to reject entries >= 0xffff with descriptive error. Verified by unit test in tests/zip.test.ts.

title: Unquoted href=javascript:, Entity Bypass, and foreignObject in optimizeSvg
description: Regex for stripping javascript: hrefs only matched quoted values (" or ') and unencoded protocols. Unquoted href=javascript:... or entity-encoded protocols like javascript: completely bypassed sanitization. foreignObject tags were unstripped.
verifier_notes: Disprover confirmed vulnerability. Added recursive foreignObject removal and robust URI entity decoding/neutralization across quoted and unquoted href/xlink:href attributes. Verified by unit test in tests/optimizeSvg.test.ts.

title: MediaStreamTrack Resource Leak in MediaRecorder Fallback
description: videoViaMediaRecorder created videoStream and combinedStream using canvas.captureStream() and vid.captureStream(), but never called track.stop() on the tracks when recording completed or failed.
verifier_notes: Disprover confirmed vulnerability. Added track.stop() cleanup loop in finally block for all active videoStream and combinedStream tracks. Verified by full test suite.

title: GNU Long Filename State Leak on Non-Regular TAR Entries
description: In readTar, when an entry has GNU long name typeflag 'L', pendingName was set. If followed by a non-regular file entry other than directory '5' (e.g. symlink '2' or device node), pendingName was not cleared and leaked to the subsequent regular file.
verifier_notes: Disprover confirmed vulnerability. Added pendingName = null reset on all non-regular entries. Verified by unit test in tests/archives.test.ts.
